title: Heartbeat Theatre
style: dramatic orchestral pop, cinematic, soaring female vocal, big strings, timpani, choir swells, piano-driven, anthemic, theatrical, key change finale
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The curtain rises on the version of me
That I keep hidden where no one can see
Under the spotlight my secrets perform
A quiet ballet in the eye of the storm

[Verse 2]
I built a stage out of every goodbye
I made a chorus of the times that I cried
Now every tremor I tried to disguise
Is an aria climbing into the skies

[Pre-Chorus]
I won't whisper anymore
No more pacing the floor
Let the orchestra roar

[Chorus]
This is the heartbeat theatre
Louder than any fear
This is the moment I face her
The woman I always was, here
This is the heartbeat theatre
Beating and burning bright
I will not dim my own light
I will not dim my own light

[Verse 3]
Once I rehearsed every line in my head
Apologies stitched into the things that I said
But the script has been rewritten tonight
And every rest is a held breath of light

[Chorus]
This is the heartbeat theatre
Louder than any fear
This is the moment I face her
The woman I always was, here
This is the heartbeat theatre
Beating and burning bright
I will not dim my own light
I will not dim my own light

[Bridge]
(Strings rise, choir enters)
I am the overture and the ending
I am the bow that will not stop bending
I am the silence before the applause
The reason, the rhythm, the cause

[Final Chorus - key change up]
This is the heartbeat theatre
The whole world a witness now
I take my place, I take my bow
I will not dim my own light
